title: [review] rules.rs:18: GLOBAL_PREFIX_TV uses fd00::/6
description: GLOBAL_PREFIX_TV is set to 0xfd00_0000... (fd00::/64 ULA prefix) but headers.rs line 147-148 defines Yggdrasil addresses as addr[0] == 0x02. Git commit b7d8cb70d9 message says 'restrict global profiles to 02xx::/8 Yggdrasil addresses'. If the network uses Yggdrasil addressing, packets with 02xx:: addresses will NOT match GLOBAL_COAP_RULE or GLOBAL_OSCORE_RULE because 0x02 != 0xfd in the MSB comparison.
